tables.title: Present Perfect Tense (المضارع التام)
rows: حدث بدأ في الماضي وما زال مستمراً
I have studied English for five years.
حدث في الماضي وله تأثير على الحاضر
أحداث حدثت في وقت غير محدد في الماضي
We haven't planned our holiday yet.
Have you ever been to London?
tables.explanation: يستخدم Present Perfect للتعبير عن أحداث بدأت في الماضي وما زالت مستمرة، أو أحداث حدثت في وقت غير محدد في الماضي ولها تأثير على الحاضر. يتكون من have/has + past participle (التصريف الثالث للفعل).
tables.examples:
I have studied English for five years.
We haven't planned our holiday yet.
Has he spoken to his boss lately?

tables.title: Reported Speech (الكلام المنقول) - شرح مفصل
rows: نستخدم said (قال) أو told (أخبر) لنقل ما قاله شخص ما.

He said that he was tired.
He told me that he was tired.
"I like pizza." → She said that she liked pizza.
you → I / he / she / they (حسب السياق)
"You are nice." → He told me that I was nice.
"We are happy." → They said that they were happy.
"My book is new." → He said that his book was new.
"Our house is big." → They said that their house was big.
"She called me." → He said that she called him.
"They helped us." → We said that they helped them.
"I like ice cream." → She said that she liked ice cream.
I am working → he was working
"I am working." → She said that she was working.
I have seen → he had seen
"I have seen Julie." → She said that she had seen Julie.
"I saw the film." → He said that he had seen the film.
I will call → he would call
"I will call you." → He said that he would call me.
I can swim → he could swim
"I can swim." → She said that she could swim.
I may come → he might come
"I may come." → He said that he might come.
I must go → he had to go
"I must go." → She said that she had to go.
"I'm busy today." → He said that he was busy that day.
tomorrow → the following day / the next day
"I'll come tomorrow." → He said that he would come the following day.
yesterday → the day before / the previous day
"I saw him yesterday." → He said that he had seen him the day before.
"I'm leaving now." → She said that she was leaving then.
"I'm here." → She said that she was there.
"This is mine." → He said that that was his.
"These are my books." → He said that those were his books.
"I saw him two years ago." → He said that he had seen him two years before.
"I'll call tonight." → He said that he would call that night.
last week → the week before / the previous week
"I visited him last week." → He said that he had visited him the previous week.
next week → the following week / the next week
"I'll travel next week." → He said that he would travel the following week.
tables.explanation: عند نقل الكلام المنقول (Reported Speech)، نقوم بـ: 1- تغيير أزمنة الأفعال إلى الماضي (Present → Past، Will → Would، إلخ). 2- تغيير الضمائر (I → he/she، my → his/her، we → they، إلخ). 3- تغيير ظروف الزمان والمكان (today → that day، here → there، tomorrow → the following day، إلخ). 4- استخدام said (بدون مفعول به) أو told (مع مفعول به) مثل told me.
tables.examples:
Direct: 'I like ice cream.' → Reported: She said that she liked ice cream.
Direct: 'I am working in London.' → Reported: She said that she was working in London.
Direct: 'I haven't seen Julie.' → Reported: She said that she hadn't seen Julie.
Direct: 'I will call you tomorrow.' → Reported: He said that he would call me the following day.

tables.title: Sequencers (أدوات الربط - للكتابة)
tables.explanation: تستخدم أدوات الربط لترتيب الأفكار والأحداث في الكتابة. First تبدأ، Then تتابع، While تعبر عن التزامن، Finally تختم.
tables.examples: First, we flew to Greece. Then, we visited some islands. Finally, we caught the plane back home.

tables.title: Prepositions (حروف الجر) - مراجعة
rows: My bag dropped into the water.
tables.explanation: حروف الجر تربط الكلمات في الجملة وتأتي مع أفعال محددة يجب حفظها.
tables.examples:
We were travelling by boat.
My bag dropped into the water.
I've tried so many new kinds of food.

tables.title: Relative Clauses (ضمائر الوصل) - مراجعة
rows: The Opera House which had beautiful architecture.
tables.explanation: تستخدم ضمائر الوصل لربط جملتين. which للشيء، who للعاقل كفاعل.
tables.examples:
We visited the Opera House which had a beautiful architecture.
The person who called me was my friend.

tables.title: Superlative Adjectives (صفات التفضيل)
rows: Australia is one of the richest continents.
The plane is the fastest way to travel.
tables.explanation: نستخدم صفات التفضيل للمقارنة بين أكثر من اثنين. نضع 'the' قبل الصفة + est أو 'the most' قبل الصفات الطويلة.
tables.examples:
Australia is one of the richest continents.
The fastest way to travel is by plane.

tables.title: Object Pronouns (ضمائر المفعول به) - مراجعة
rows: A bus was waiting to drive us.
tables.explanation: ضمائر المفعول به تأتي بعد الفعل أو حرف الجر.
tables.examples:
A bus was waiting to drive us to the hotel.
We thanked him for his efforts.

tables.title: Articles (أدوات التعريف والتنكير) - مراجعة
rows: قبل الكلمات التي تبدأ بحرف ساكن
قبل الكلمات التي تبدأ بحرف علة
tables.explanation: نستخدم a قبل الأسماء التي تبدأ بحرف ساكن، و an قبل الأسماء التي تبدأ بحرف علة. نستخدم the للشيء المحدد والمعروف.
tables.examples:
The tourist company had done an amazing job.
We arrived at the hotel.
